review_description: Throughout the entire process I was kept informed, assisted when I had a query and I ended up with a great system at an excellent price which was expertly installed. No pressure to purchase after my initial query. Just information as I requested it. The pre sale and after sales service has been impeccable. This is the second time I’ve used Regen and I cannot fault them. I highly recommend this professional, courteous and helpful team.

I decided to stay away from the bigger national companies due to their reputation for poor quality and dodgy installation.The small company I chose is only a two man operation, but their knowledge and efficiency was noteworthy. They turned up at my house at precisely the time quoted.Their price was not the cheapest around but I feel I got above average quality of materials used for my installation.I would be happy to recommend their business.
